summary: Lists projects affected by a vulnerability identified by its `source` and `vuln` values. Use `searchText` to match project names case insensitively, and pair `pageNumber` with `pageSize` or `offset` with `limit` to paginate results. The authenticated user must have `VIEW_PORTFOLIO` permission.

Creates a new scheduled notification rule. Supply `level`, `name`, `publisher`, and `scope`, with the publisher identified by its UUID; `name` must contain 1 to 255 characters matching the allowed character pattern. You need `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION` or `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION_CREATE` permission.
Returns all permissions the authenticated user has, including those inherited from teams.

Authenticates an OpenID Connect user by validating an `idToken`. Send the request as form-encoded data; include `accessToken` if your authentication flow requires it. A successful response provides a bearer token for REST API authentication.

Retrieves the configuration schema for a notification publisher. Use this operation to determine the configuration fields supported by the publisher; the authenticated user needs `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION` or `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION_READ` permission.
Retrieves an SVG badge showing current policy violation metrics for a project. Supply the project's UUID in `uuid` to select the project. The badge is unavailable when badges are disabled.

Date format must be YYYYMMDD. The number of days returned is computed against the current UTC date.

Requires permission VIEW_PORTFOLIO

Requires permission VIEW_PORTFOLIO

The withVulnerabilities and vdr variants further require any of the following permissions:

  • VIEW_VULNERABILITY
  • VULNERABILITY_ANALYSIS
  • VULNERABILITY_ANALYSIS_READ
Retrieves an SVG badge showing current vulnerability metrics for a project. Supply the project's UUID in `uuid` to select the project. The badge is unavailable when badges are disabled.

Updates the comment on an API key identified by its public ID or, for a legacy key, its complete key value. Send the comment as a plain-text request body; the authenticated user must have `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` or `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission. A successful response returns the updated API key.
Retrieves a vulnerability using its source and source-specific identifier. Supply `source` and `vuln` to identify the record; access requires `VIEW_PORTFOLIO` permission.

Retrieves an SVG badge showing current policy violation metrics for a project identified by name and version. Use `name` and `version` to select the project whose badge you want to display. The badge is unavailable when badges are disabled.

Date format must be YYYYMMDD. The date is interpreted as UTC midnight.

Requires permission VIEW_PORTFOLIO

Date format must be YYYYMMDD. The date is interpreted as UTC midnight.

Requires permission VIEW_PORTFOLIO

Retrieves an SVG badge showing current vulnerability metrics for a project identified by name and version. Use `name` and `version` to select the project whose badge you want to display. The badge is unavailable when badges are disabled.

Updates multiple configuration properties from an array of property entries. The authenticated user must have `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION` or `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION_UPDATE` permission, and each entry must include `groupName` and `propertyName`. The response reports the result for each entry, including an error message when a property cannot be updated.

Updates a user's password after validating the supplied login credentials. Send `username`, `password`, `newPassword`, and `confirmPassword` as form-encoded fields, with matching new and confirmation passwords.

Updates an existing notification publisher, including its extension, name, description, and notification template. Supply `extensionName`, `name`, and `uuid`; the authenticated user needs `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION` or `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION_UPDATE` permission. A 200 response returns the updated notification publisher.

Creates a new notification publisher with its extension, name, and optional template details. Supply `extensionName` and `name`; the authenticated user needs `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION` or `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION_CREATE` permission. A 201 response returns the created notification publisher with its generated UUID.
Deletes multiple projects identified by their UUIDs. Pass a unique array of 1–1,000 project UUIDs in the request body; you need `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT` or `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT_DELETE` permission.

Records an analysis decision for a policy violation affecting a component. Provide the `component` and `policyViolation` UUIDs, and optionally set `analysisState`, add a `comment`, or update suppression status. The authenticated user needs `POLICY_VIOLATION_ANALYSIS` permission.

Updates an existing notification rule using its UUID. Supply `uuid`, `name`, `level`, and `scope`, and include optional notification, filtering, publisher, or scheduling settings as needed. You need `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION` or `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION_UPDATE` permission.

Creates a new notification rule. Supply `level`, `name`, `publisher`, and `scope`, with the publisher identified by its UUID. You need `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION` or `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION_CREATE` permission.

Retrieves the latest available version metadata for a component from configured repositories. Supply `purl` as a valid Package URL; when metadata is available, the response includes the latest version and publication timestamp.

Calculates OWASP Risk Rating likelihood and impact scores from an OWASP Risk Rating vector. Supply a valid `vector` to calculate the likelihood, technical impact, and business impact scores. The response also includes the corresponding HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW ratings.

Calculates CVSS base, impact, and exploitability scores from a CVSS vector. Supply a valid `vector` using CVSS v2, v3, or v4. The response includes the calculated scores and any applicable temporal or environmental scores.

Lists concise records for all licenses available through the license catalogue. Use this endpoint when you need license identifiers, display names, and classification flags without retrieving full license text.

Replaces a team's permissions with the supplied list. Provide `team` and `permissions`, using supported permission names without duplicates. The authenticated user must have `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` or `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission.

Replaces a user's permissions with the supplied list. Provide `username` and `permissions`, using supported permission names without duplicates. The authenticated user must have `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` or `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission.

Sets the teams assigned to a user, replacing the specified team membership set. Supply the user's `username` and an array of team UUIDs; each UUID must be unique. You need the `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` or `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission.
Reports whether OpenID Connect is available for the application. Use the boolean result to determine whether OpenID Connect is available before relying on it.

Clones an existing project and lets you choose which project data to include. Supply the source project UUID in `project` and a non-empty `version` for the clone; the response provides a token for checking cloning progress. This operation is deprecated; use `/api/v2/projects/{uuid}/clone` instead.

Creates a mapping between an LDAP group distinguished name and a team. Supply the `dn` and `team` fields in the JSON body; you need the `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` or `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT_CREATE` permission. A successful response includes the mapping's UUID.

Creates a mapping between an OIDC group and a team. Supply `group` and `team` as UUID-formatted values to associate them. The authenticated user must have `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` or `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT_CREATE` permission.
Optional query parameter searchText. The search is case insensitive and matches team names.

Updates an existing managed user account. Supply `username` and `lastPasswordChange`, then include the account fields you want to update. You need the `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` or `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission.

Creates a managed user account. Supply `username` and `lastPasswordChange`; include any other account details, permissions, or teams you want to set. You need the `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` or `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT_CREATE` permission.

Creates an ACL mapping between a project and a team. Supply `project` and `team` as UUIDs; the authenticated user needs the `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` permission. Use this operation to grant a team access to a project through an ACL mapping.

This API performs a pass-through query to the configured LDAP server.

Requires permission ACCESS_MANAGEMENT or ACCESS_MANAGEMENT_READ
Invalidates the authenticated user's current session. Logout is a no-op when you authenticate with an API key; send the optional `Authorization` header to identify the session to invalidate.

Authenticates a user by validating `username` and `password` credentials. Send the credentials as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`; a successful response contains a bearer token for REST API authentication.
Retrieves the team associated with the authenticated user's API key. Use this endpoint to inspect the team's name, UUID, permissions, and associated users.

Creates an LDAP-backed user that references an existing LDAP object. Supply the required `username` and the LDAP `dn`; the authenticated user needs `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` or `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT_CREATE` permission.

Creates a user account that references an existing OpenID Connect user. Supply the required `username` and add the OIDC subject identifier, email, permissions, or teams as needed. You need the `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` or `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT_CREATE` permission.
Retrieves information about the authenticated user. Use this endpoint to inspect the user's username, email, permissions, and team memberships.

Updates the profile information for the authenticated user. Supply `username` and `lastPasswordChange`, and include any other profile fields you want to change. The response contains the updated user object.

Lists occurrences associated with a specific component. Use `pageNumber` with `pageSize`, or `offset` with `limit`, to control the returned results; you can also sort by a field using `sortName` and `sortOrder`.

Removes a named tag from one or more notification rules. Supply an array of 1–100 notification rule UUIDs; the authenticated user must have `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION` or `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION_UPDATE` permission.

Tags one or more notification rules with the named tag. Supply an array of 1–100 notification rule UUIDs; the authenticated user must have `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION` or `SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION_UPDATE` permission.

Updates the tags associated with a vulnerability identified by its UUID. Send an optional JSON array of tag strings; the authenticated user needs `VULNERABILITY_MANAGEMENT` or `VULNERABILITY_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission. The response contains the updated vulnerability.

Creates a component in the specified project. Supply `classifier`, `name`, `project`, and `uuid`; `classifier` must use an accepted value, and the authenticated user must have `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT` or `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission. A 201 response returns the created component.

Deletes the association between a tag and one or more vulnerabilities. Supply vulnerability UUIDs in the request body; the array must contain between 1 and 100 UUID strings. The authenticated user must have `VULNERABILITY_MANAGEMENT` or `VULNERABILITY_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission.

Lists findings for a specific project, or returns a SARIF document when you request `application/sarif+json`. Use `searchText`, source and analysis filters, or either pagination pair to narrow the results. You need the `VIEW_VULNERABILITY` permission to access the project.

Creates a new service for the project identified by `uuid`. When you provide a service object, include `name`, `project`, and `uuid`; you need `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT` or `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT_CREATE` permission. A successful response returns the created service object.

Removes the specified user from a team. Provide the user's `username` and the team's `uuid` in the request. The authenticated user needs `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` or `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT_DELETE` permission to make this change.

Adds the specified user to a team. Provide the user's `username` and the team's `uuid` in the request. The authenticated user needs `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` or `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission to make this change.

This endpoint is intended to be used in conjunction with other API calls which return a token for asynchronous tasks. The token can then be queried using this endpoint to determine if the task is complete:

  • A value of true indicates processing is occurring.
  • A value of false indicates that no processing is occurring for the specified token.
However, a value of false also does not confirm the token is valid, only that no processing is associated with the specified token.

Deletes the association between a tag and one or more projects. Supply project UUIDs in the request body; the array must contain between 1 and 100 UUID strings. The authenticated user must have `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT` or `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission.
Tags one or more projects with the named tag. Supply an array of 1–100 project UUIDs; the authenticated user must have `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT` or `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission.
Removes a named tag from one or more policies. Supply an array of 1–100 policy UUIDs; the authenticated user must have `POLICY_MANAGEMENT` or `POLICY_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission.
Tags one or more policies with the named tag. Supply an array of 1–100 policy UUIDs; the authenticated user must have `POLICY_MANAGEMENT` or `POLICY_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission.

This endpoint is intended to be used in conjunction with uploading a supported BOM document. Upon upload, a token will be returned. The token can then be queried using this endpoint to determine if any tasks (such as vulnerability analysis) is being performed on the BOM:

  • A value of true indicates processing is occurring.
  • A value of false indicates that no processing is occurring for the specified token.
However, a value of false also does not confirm the token is valid, only that no processing is associated with the specified token.

Requires permission BOM_UPLOAD

Deprecated. Use /v1/event/token/{uuid} instead.
Requires authentication, but no permission. Returns both internal and public properties
Retrieves a public configuration property by its group and property names. Use `groupName` and `propertyName` to identify the value you want to retrieve.

Removes a permission from a team. Supply the team UUID in `uuid` and the permission to remove in `permission`. The authenticated user must have `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` or `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT_DELETE` permission.
Adds a permission to a team. Supply the team UUID in `uuid` and a valid permission in `permission`. The authenticated user must have `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` or `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission.

Updates an existing vulnerability record, including its identifiers, affected components, and scoring data. Supply `uuid` to identify the record and the required `friendlyVulnId`, `source`, and `vulnId`; you also need `VULNERABILITY_MANAGEMENT` or `VULNERABILITY_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission.

Creates a vulnerability record with its identifiers, affected components, and scoring data. Include `friendlyVulnId`, `source`, `uuid`, and `vulnId`; you also need `VULNERABILITY_MANAGEMENT` or `VULNERABILITY_MANAGEMENT_CREATE` permission.

Updates an existing component using the supplied component properties. When you provide a body, include `classifier`, `name`, `project`, and `uuid`; the authenticated user also needs PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT or PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE permission. The response contains the updated component.

Records an analysis decision for a vulnerability affecting a component. Supply `component` and `vulnerability`, and add analysis state, justification, response, or comments as needed. The authenticated user needs the `VULNERABILITY_ANALYSIS` or `VULNERABILITY_ANALYSIS_UPDATE` permission.

Lists licenses with their complete metadata, including license text, identifiers, approval flags, and associated license groups. Use `pageNumber` and `pageSize` or `offset` and `limit` to control which licenses are returned.

Updates an existing project, including its metadata, access teams, and parent relationship. Supply `name` and `uuid` in the body; set `parent` to an object containing the new parent’s `uuid`, or omit it or set it to `null` to remove the parent. You need `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT` or `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission.

Creates a project, optionally under a parent project and with team-based access. Supply `name` and `uuid`; set `parent` to an object containing the parent’s `uuid`, or omit it or set it to `null` to create a top-level project. You need `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT` or `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT_CREATE` permission.

Updates an existing service record with its metadata, data flows, references, and related project and provider information. Supply the service object with `name`, `project`, and `uuid`; you need `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT` or `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission. A successful response returns the updated service object.

Updates an existing policy. If you submit a request body, include `name`, `operator`, `uuid`, and `violationState`; the body itself may be omitted. The authenticated user must have `POLICY_MANAGEMENT` or `POLICY_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission.

Creates a new policy. If you submit a request body, include `name`, `operator`, `uuid`, and `violationState`; the body itself may be omitted. The authenticated user must have `POLICY_MANAGEMENT` or `POLICY_MANAGEMENT_CREATE` permission.

Updates fields on an existing team, including its name, users, permissions, API keys, and identity-provider mappings. Send the team values you want to update; `name` must be 1 to 255 characters and contain no control characters. The authenticated user must have `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` or `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission.

Creates a new team with its name and any supplied users, permissions, API keys, service accounts, and identity-provider mappings. Send the team fields to include; `name` must be 1 to 255 characters and contain no control characters. The authenticated user must have `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` or `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT_CREATE` permission.

Uploads a CycloneDX bill of materials (BOM) and starts processing it for a project. Send the BOM as multipart form data; identify the project with `project`, or supply both `projectName` and `projectVersion`, and use `autoCreate` to create a project when needed. The response includes a token for checking processing progress; BOM uploads require the `BOM_UPLOAD` permission, and creating a project also requires one of the documented project-creation permissions.

Uploads a Base64-encoded CycloneDX bill of materials (BOM) and associates it with a project. Supply `project`, `projectName`, and `projectVersion` as required by the schema, and use `autoCreate` to create a project when it does not exist. Processing is asynchronous; use the returned `token` to check progress, and send large BOMs through the POST upload endpoint to avoid the 20,000,000-character limit.

Lists CWE records, optionally filtered by a case-insensitive substring in the CWE name or CWE ID. Use `pageNumber` with `pageSize`, or `offset` with `limit`, to paginate results; `sortName` and `sortOrder` control ordering.

Deletes one or more tags by name. You can delete tags without assigned projects or policies with `TAG_MANAGEMENT` permission; assigned tags require the applicable portfolio or policy permissions and project access. Supply between 1 and 100 distinct tag names when you provide a request body.
Creates one or more tags from a list of tag names. Supply between 1 and 100 distinct names in the request body; you need `TAG_MANAGEMENT` permission. The response confirms that the tags were created.

Uploads a CycloneDX VEX document for a project using multipart form data. Identify the project with `project`, or provide `projectName` and `projectVersion`; the VEX is validated against the CycloneDX schema. The authenticated user needs `VULNERABILITY_ANALYSIS` or `VULNERABILITY_ANALYSIS_UPDATE` permission, and the response includes a token for checking processing progress.

Uploads a base64-encoded CycloneDX VEX document for a project. Provide `project`, `projectName`, `projectVersion`, and `vex`; `project` must be a UUID, and `vex` must contain valid base64-encoded data. The `vex` value is limited to 20,000,000 characters, so use POST for larger documents; the response includes a token for checking processing progress.

Retrieves the details for a specific license identified by its SPDX License ID. Use `licenseId` to select the license; the response includes license text, comments, related license groups, and reference URLs when available.

Updates selected fields on an existing project, including its name, status, metadata, and parent. Supply the project fields you want to change; to re-parent the project, set `parent` to an object containing the new parent’s `uuid`, or omit `parent` or set it to `null` to leave the parent unchanged. You need the `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT` or `PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT_UPDATE` permission.
Retrieves a specific CWE by its identifier. Supply the `cweId` path parameter to select the CWE record.
Returns a simple json object containing the name of the application and the version
